day.description: the UTC day the entry closes

first_day.description: start of the log; equal to erster_tag of the protocol key list

log_id.description: equal to log_id of the protocol key list; a log for trials starts with staging-

prev_hash.description: Hex(SHA-256(UTF-8(statement_jcs))) of the entry for the previous day; 64 zeros if and only if day = first_day

root.description: Hex(root(day)); for tree_size 0 the SHA-256 value of the empty byte string

server_ts.description: the instant the vendor's signing service fixes before it forms the entry (heartbeat spec 9.9), exactly YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ; MUST be at least end(day); the fillers do not depend on it (format spec 7.4.4)

tree_size.description: number of leaves of the day tree

description: statement_jcs is the JCS form of a value of $defs/statement; only its UTF-8 bytes are signed, by a protocol key (format spec 7.4.5)

server_key_id.description: a protocol key of the vendor log (format spec 7.4.7), never a key of another role (format spec 10.7.3)

server_signature.description: Ed25519 by that protocol key over the UTF-8 bytes of statement_jcs

statement_jcs.description: the day entry in JCS form (RFC 8785), printable ASCII; only these UTF-8 bytes are signed

title: Day entry of the vendor log: ledger.vendor_log_day.v1
